role_summary: I'm a Cargo Handler, bottom rung of Services. I move, strap, count and shelve whatever the ship carries, and I like a bay where every crate is where the manifest says it is. Nobody notices cargo until a pallet comes loose, so I mostly want to be left alone to do it right and get to my coffee.

personas.quirk: Reads every strap tension twice and initials the manifest in green pen
personas.routine_effect: Always proper-quality loops; extra manifest audit at h 5; short break; rarely at the bar

personas.quirk: Hums while hauling and stacks the lighter crates on top as a rule of thumb
personas.routine_effect: Longer mess and lounge time; rushes the 2nd strap check when busy; gossips with every passerby

personas.quirk: Keeps a pocket of salvaged parts and rebuilds cargo sleds in spare time
personas.routine_effect: Swaps recreation for workshop time; yawns early on duty; skips the gym

daily_template.note: Take the manifest and any flagged pallets from the outgoing handler
Count crates against the manifest, check straps and seals
Move supplies to stores for galley, replicator techs and engineering
Mid-watch meal with the other handlers
Stage and move cargo to or from the pads, or the shuttlebay
Final manifest update, re-tension straps, log anything missing
Main sleep; interrupted only by red alert
Letters home, laundry, tinkering before the next watch

activities.label: Cards on a crate
activities.note: Crate-top poker with other handlers, in the quiet hour

activities.label: Fix up a cargo sled
activities.note: Job-specific: rebuilds wobbly hover sleds and trade parts

activities.label: Walk the arboretum
activities.note: Only place on the ship that smells like outside

duty_loops.label: Count and verify cargo against manifest
Check straps, seals and nets
duty_loops.bridge_report: Bridge, Cargo. Bay one secured for maneuvers.

duty_loops.label: Stage cargo for the pads or shuttlebay
steps: confirm weight and mass with transporter tech

quiet_watch.if_neglected: Manifest drifts; the galley runs short

survey.task: Stage sensor drones and sample cases at the shuttlebay
Clear a sample storage rack in the bay
survey.if_neglected: Samples are left in the corridor

survey.task: Move returned specimen cases to the lab

cargo_run.task: Verify manifest and tie-down for outbound load
Stage crates on the transporter pads
Receive inbound load and shelve in bay
cargo_run.if_neglected: Pads jammed, incoming load stuck in the buffer

cargo_run.task: Close out manifest and report totals

medical_relief.task: Pull medical supply crates from the bay
Haul crates to sickbay and shelve them
medical_relief.if_neglected: Aid stays stuck in the bay

medical_relief.task: Clear a quarantine corner in the bay
medical_relief.if_neglected: No place to isolate contaminated gear

shakedown.task: Strap down everything in the bay before maneuvers
shakedown.if_neglected: Loose cargo goes airborne in a hard turn

shakedown.task: Test the cargo lift and sled

calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Cargo. Bay is strapped and sealed. Ready for maneuvers.
Bridge, Cargo. Unmarked container in the bay, leaking something. Request a tech.
Bridge, Cargo. Pallet broke loose in bay one. I'm clear, but hold the hard turns.

calls_to_bridge.trigger: Fire or breach in the bay
calls_to_bridge.message: Bridge, Cargo! Fire in the cargo bay! I'm evacuating, seal it!
Bridge, Cargo. Load delivered, manifest closed. Totals match.

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Cargo, aye. Pulling the load now.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: Load not on manifest or unsafe to move

calls_from_bridge.response_line: Bay is tight. Counts match the manifest.

calls_from_bridge.order: Clear the bay and seal the doors
calls_from_bridge.response_line: Cargo, clearing. Seal it behind me.
Cargo, aye, if you're sure. Confirm. That's the manifest, sir.
calls_from_bridge.refuses_if: The order isn't confirmed by an officer

yellow.action: Re-check straps, clear aisles, stack loose gear down low

red.action: Strap down, then go to the assigned station in the bay and wait for orders
red.comm_line: Cargo at station. Bay secured, standing by.

fire.action: Grab extinguisher, fight a small fire, otherwise evacuate and seal the bay
fire.comm_line: Cargo. Fire in the bay! Pulling the extinguisher, or evacuating.

hull_breach.action: Run for the nearest seal, grab a patch kit if close, shut the bay door behind me
hull_breach.comm_line: Cargo. Breach in the bay! Sealing the door!

contamination.action: Lock down the bay, seal the stored goods, wait in quarantine
contamination.comm_line: Cargo. Bay sealed, quarantine in effect.

power_failure.action: Use handlight, lock the cargo lift, keep crates from sliding
power_failure.comm_line: Cargo. Bay is dark. Using handlights.

gravity_failure.action: Grab a strap line, anchor the loose crates, stay clear of floating pallets
gravity_failure.comm_line: Cargo. Gravity's out. Crates are floating, I'm anchoring them.

intruder.action: Lock the bay, hide behind the heavy crates, stay off comms unless asked
intruder.comm_line: Cargo. Bay locked. Keeping my head down.

medical_emergency.action: Bring a sled or stretcher cart to the call, clear the corridor
medical_emergency.comm_line: Cargo. Bringing a sled. Who is it?

abandon_ship.action: Drop everything, head for the shuttlebay, help load supply crates on the way
abandon_ship.comm_line: Cargo. Heading to the shuttlebay, bringing rations.

nominal.routine_change: Normal hauling, long lunches, gossip in the bay

anomalies.routine_change: Re-checks straps twice, asks the quartermaster about odd noises or flickering lights
lines: Lights keep flickering in the bay.
Heard a thump in the stack. Probably nothing.

degraded.routine_change: Skips the third inventory pass, starts moving valuables to safe spots, shortens meals
lines: Half the lifts are down. I'm carrying it by hand.
degraded.leaves_post_if: Bay becomes unsafe: fire, leak or no gravity

crisis.routine_change: Only moves critical supplies (medical, rations, patches); ignores the manifest
lines: Forget the manifest, what do you need?
Tell me where to haul it.
crisis.leaves_post_if: Ordered out or the bay can't be sealed

collapse.routine_change: Stops counting; hauls survivors' gear to the shuttlebay or sits by the bay door
lines: It doesn't matter what's in the crates now.
I'm taking the rations. Come on.
collapse.leaves_post_if: Always, once abandon ship is called

relationships.effect: Takes orders and reports to the quartermaster; wants the QM's approval and fears blame for losses
Eats with the cooks, gets first pick of fresh stock, delivers extras to the galley
Trades parts and gossip with the replicator techs, restocks their feedstock first
Coordinates pad loads; lets the tech skip checks only if both agree
Security checks seals and inspects crates; the handler resents delays and the extra paperwork

greeting_player: Watch your step in the bay.
greeting_player_lower_rank: New? I'll show you the straps.
tired: My back's done for the day.
One more crate and I'm gone.
hungry: I could eat a whole pallet.

player_reactions.player_does_their_job_well: Respects them, offers coffee and shows the good shortcuts in the bay.
player_reactions.player_neglects_duty: Mutters, tidies their share quietly, then mentions it to the quartermaster if it repeats.
player_reactions.player_fakes_report: Spots mismatched counts at once and says so; will cover a first slip but not a second.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_ok: Complies at once with 'aye', then double-checks the details.
player_reactions.player_gives_order_outranked: Hesitates, says the quartermaster told them differently, and asks for it confirmed.
player_reactions.player_out_of_place: Warns them off the moving loads and asks what they're doing in the bay.
player_reactions.player_asks_favour: Helps if it is a quick haul or a spare strap; refuses to touch the manifest without the QM.

decision_rules: IF the bridge orders a load moved THEN verify it against the manifest, then move it and report done.
IF a crate is leaking or unmarked THEN back away, seal the area, and call the bridge or a tech.
IF a pallet has shifted and the bridge is about to maneuver THEN warn the bridge before touching it.
IF I'm exhausted and the count is nearly done THEN rush the last row, but never skip the straps.
IF the quartermaster and a higher officer give conflicting orders THEN do the safer one and tell the QM.
IF a friend asks me to slip something off the manifest THEN refuse unless it's medical or an emergency.
IF gravity fails THEN anchor the heaviest crates first, then everything else.
IF the bay is on fire and the extinguisher doesn't work in 30 seconds THEN leave and seal it.
IF no one is watching and the count is a few units off THEN recount once, then log it honestly.
IF abandon ship is called THEN grab rations and a medkit crate and head for the shuttlebay.
information_view: The bay is the first to feel gravity wobble, loose pallets, odd drafts, leaks and strange smells, and cargo is the first to run out. I see shortages, tag mismatches, stuck lifts and pad glitches before the bridge does, but I don't see why engineering systems fail.
temptations: Skipping the second strap check when tired: the pallet slips during a turn and may injure someone.
Faking the manifest count to leave early: the shortage turns up during a mission and the quartermaster blames me.
Taking a snack or spare part from stock: small, but it leaves a hole the galley notices.
Napping behind the crates during a slow watch: nobody notices until a call comes in and I'm late.
